8b585b85cca9001001ffd484842db64809d78025.summary: Okta's Threat Intelligence team links cluster O-UNC-053, which uses voice phishing and phishing kits to take over accounts and steal data, to a new data leak site called INCEPTION. Okta says the cluster was previously assessed to be affiliated with ShinyHunters. INCEPTION denies any ShinyHunters link. Okta says it is unclear whether the leaked data is authentic. The Hacker News reports that Palo Alto Networks Unit 42 found more than 70 legal-themed lookalike domains since October 2026, and that ReversingLabs described the filtered phishing kit. Targets span many sectors.
